_comment: VIRAL PRODUCT DEMO — 4s hook + ~12s of product, voiceover variant. Generalised from a production config; every project-specific value is a <placeholder> describing what belongs there. Copy to runs/<run_id>/inputs.json and fill it in. See references/formats.md §1.
_startingPoint: A proven starting point, not a spec. These durations, cut counts and the with/without-voice choice all worked for someone else's audience — tweak them for yours, one variable per experiment, and see references/formats.md if you want to try a format that isn't in this folder at all.

meta.title: <slug-for-this-video>
meta.concept: <the one thing this video shows the product doing, in a sentence>

_topic._comment: Volume formats work off a rotating list of topics so every run is a different video. Keep the list in the engine folder — inputs/topics.json with {waiting:[], used:[]} — and move one across per run. Never pick a used topic; that's how the same video gets made twice.
_topic.value: <the subject of THIS video — the query, symptom, use case or persona it speaks to>

segments._note: The scroll-stopper, and the ONLY A/B variable in this format. Does NOT show the product — a face, a result, a mess, a question. Shot vertically, looks filmed not produced.

backgroundFootage.file: <shared/assets/hooks-5s/ — a clip of a person, filmed-not-produced>

segments._note: First thing the product does. One idea per cut — the tap, not the tour.

backgroundFootage.file: <shared/assets/screen-recordings/ — the action that matches this beat>

segments._note: The second result, or the moment that makes it worth downloading.

voiceOverlay._comment: Optional in this format. When present it carries the demo and the music MUST drop to 0.03 — see musicBackground below.
voiceOverlay._voiceRule: Match the voice to whoever is on screen in the hook. A woman on screen with a male narrator is a mismatch viewers feel without naming.
_scriptTemplate: <Open on the question or tension the topic creates — one line, no greeting.>
<One sentence of real substance: why it happens / what it means. Under 25 words.>
And if you made it this far, this is probably for you. It's called <PRODUCT NAME> and it <the one-line promise from shared/brand.md>.
voiceOverlay.fullScript: <the rendered script — write it out, read it aloud, keep it under maximumCharacters>
voiceOverlay._captionNote: Burn captions. Most of the feed watches muted.

musicBackground.file: <shared/assets/music/ — a bed you have the rights to>
musicBackground._volumeRule: 0.5 with NO voiceover — the bed carries the video. Drop to 0.03 the moment a voiceover exists, or it fights the voice and loudness normalisation makes it worse.

_rules: The hook is the experiment. Hold the demo segments constant across arms.
If the voiceover runs past the last segment, repeat the last clip rather than cutting the audio.
Real screen recordings beat stock every time in this format — references/clip-sourcing.md.
Never reuse both the same inputs and the same durations — references/duplicate-safety.md.
